question: Who has won the 'battle of Hydaspes'?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Alexander__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Battle of Hydaspes** was a battle fought between **Alexander the Great and the King Porus** in 326 BC.
 
• **It ended in a victory for Alexander's Macedonian Army**.
 
• The **Battle of the Hydaspes** was also the most costly battle fought by the **Macedonians.**
 
• **Sikandar** is the Persian rendition of the name Alexander.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The **battle of Hydaspes** resulted in a victory and the surrender of **King Porus.**
